edition: v1.10, August 2013 (copy hosted by the Game Audio Podcast; Sony publishes no official copy)
issuer: Sony Worldwide Studios Audio Standards Working Group (ASWG)
name: Average Loudness and Peak Levels of Audio Content on Sony Computer Entertainment Platforms (Recommendation ASWG-R001)
statement: Sony's recommendation for the average loudness (ITU-R BS.1770-3, LKFS), loudness range (EBU Tech 3342) and true peak of audio content in titles for home-based and portable SCE platforms. Index row I03.
